 Find hotels with breakfast included in las vegas for 3 adults to stay in two rooms from April 10 to april 23

parameters.return_text:
The current webpage is a hotel booking website, and the previous actions have led to the search results page for Las Vegas hotels. The last action was to click on the "i" icon, which likely expanded the search criteria or displayed additional information about the search results.

Based on the screenshot, there are several hotels displayed on the page, but none of them have breakfast included in the price. To find hotels with breakfast included, the next action should be to click on the "Filters" button, which is located on the top right side of the page. This will open a dropdown menu where the user can select the "Meals Included" option and choose "Breakfast" to filter the search results to only show hotels that include breakfast in the price.
